climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Georgia AVA on the northeastern part of the Dahlonega Plateau, in the northern foothills of the Georgia Piedmont. It covers parts of Lumpkin and White counties, and was Georgia's second AVA, created in 2018.
